|How does the multiple network traffic that you generate on your devices work? How do all of them work parallely?

|Is IP guaranteed of delivery while sending a packet? (I'm paraphrasing, I don't remember the exact wording)

|What happens if duplicate packets are sent out the sender shuts down or something in the middle of transmission?

|Given two linked lists of numbers, give us the time complexity for checking if they are sorted and if they are, give us the complexity and pseudo-code for merging them

|What is encapsulation? What is abstraction? What is the difference between Object oriented and functional programming paradigms?

|Given, ax CFL -> CSL -> Recursive -> Recursively Enumerable), give reasons which of the ones are closed under complementation.

|What is vertex cover? What problem do you reduce it to to show NP completeness? What approximation algo do you know for i

|What is a pipe ? What is a shared Memory ? also discuss about how you'll create/use them ? What are their differences ?

|Actual available memory might be less than Virt. Mem (2^32), so there'll be a check if it is in memory bounds, and hence we'll have less no. of entries 

|There is 1000 credits in your account and the amount in your account has to be at least 500 and two transactions happen one credits 1000 and on debits 800. Which property fails if debit occurs first?

|In the credit transaction if 1000 is debit from friends account but 1000 is not credit in your account. Which property failed?

|Who generates the segments? What happens to the address in a branch op when it is loaded in the memory

|What is Binary Tree, Binary Search Tree, Worst case complexity of Binary Search Tree. What is meant by balanced binary tree?

|Suppose you are told that a language model has a perplexity of 100. What can you say about that language model?

|How is timer implemented in a computer? Where is timer situated? Inside cpu? Outside cpu? Inside disk drive? Where?

|Consider a collection of functions on real numbers, such that fRg if g = O(f) (R is a relation). Is this relation a POSET?

|Do you know Euler’s Algorithm? what is the running time of this algorithm? If I follow a naive approach of iterating over the numbers and checking GCD, what will be running time? 

|so suppose you are given a DAG. How would you find shortest distance between two nodes. what if edge cost are not 1.

|What is hamoltanian path, how will you find hamoltanion path in a graph. Which problem would you reduce to get hamoltanion path.
